hypothesis.statement: A learned sequential target-exposure policy improves out-of-sample net return of the six-symbol fleet aggregate over matched non-RL decision rules when observations, costs, execution assumptions and the safety shield are identical.
hypothesis.economicMechanism: Position management is sequential because proportional costs make the value of a target depend on the exposure already held, funding accrues to the position carried across settlements, and the trailing-drawdown gate makes future admissible actions depend on past losses. A myopic rule ignores these couplings.
hypothesis.whySequential: Reward at t depends on the inherited position (turnover cost, funding) and the action changes the state seen at t+1 (exposure, drawdown gate, bars since fill).

pilotDisclosure: Before this registration, implementation-validation pilots were run on the development panel only: one PPO (300k steps, seed 1) and one TD3 (60k steps, seed 1) fit on the first 60% of bars and inspected on the 60-80% slice, plus a shuffled-bar placebo and feature-statistics checks. The pilot showed a favourable PPO result on a strongly rising window (buy-and-hold Sharpe 2.01 on the same slice). Two design changes followed from pilots: the drawdown gate moved from an all-time to a trailing 120-bar peak, and a vacuous per-step limit was removed from the shield. No hyperparameter was tuned on pilot outcomes; values below are fixed defaults. All development data was already contaminated before this campaign.

data.universeNote: Symbols are the production fleet reviewed on 2026-11-11 plus BTC as a benchmark. The fleet was chosen with knowledge of history through 2026, so the universe carries selection and survivorship bias; no delisted instrument is represented. A symbol enters at its first listed bar plus the 60-bar burn-in.

development.contamination: Previously exposed. The same calendar span was used by 45 earlier residual/funding trials and by sequential_control_screen_v1. It is development evidence only.

confirmation.limits: 308 bars per symbol, of which the first 60 are burn-in because the preceding weeks are sealed. Policies are trained on data ending 2025-03-17, 13.5 months earlier. The window is a single short regime and is power-limited.

data.availability: Historical timestamps only; no first-seen witnesses. Provider revisions cannot be excluded. Funding marks missing from the event are resolved from the open of the containing 1h mark bar.
data.license: Provider market-data terms. Raw data and model artifacts are not committed.

environment.model: Constrained POMDP. Market state is partially observed and non-stationary; price and funding paths are exogenous (price-taker replay), account state is action-dependent.
environment.observation: 15 causal market features (fixed transforms, no fitted scaler) and 4 account-state features; 60-bar burn-in.
environment.action: Raw proposal in [-1, 1]; an absolute target, not an increment. Target exposure = trunc(raw * 1666) in units of 1e-4 of account equity.

shield.riskOff: reduce-only when drawdown >= limit or snapshot not fresh
shield.invalidProposal: rejected; fallback proposes the current exposure

environment.timing: Decide at close t on bars <= t; fill at open t+1; funding stamped at open t+1 settles on the pre-fill position, funding inside the bar on the post-fill position; equity marked at close t+1.
environment.reward: 100 * (equity[t+1] - equity[t]) / equity[t], with equity net of costs and funding. No shaping in the primary reward. No external cash flows exist in the simulation.
environment.discountRationale: About 100 bars (25 days) effective horizon, longer than the reference rules' median holding periods (2-10 bars) and well inside a continuing task.
environment.episodes: Training: random symbol and start, 256 decisions, time-limit truncation with bootstrap from the true successor. Termination only at the insolvency floor (equity <= 0.5), with liquidation at cost and no bootstrap. Evaluation: one account per symbol from flat over the whole window, liquidated at cost at the end; that liquidation is evaluation accounting and not a training signal.
environment.costRationale: 5 bp taker fee + 1.5 bp slippage + 1.5 bp half-spread, close to the fleet's calibrated combo costs. One uniform rate for all symbols is a simplification.
environment.limits: OHLCV replay supports a price-taker exposure experiment only. No queue-position, intrabar, liquidation-engine or market-impact claim. Open of bar t+1 is assumed tradable at cost.

validation.design: Expanding walk-forward on the development panel; boundaries in calendar time.
validation.purgeRationale: A decision's reward matures at the close of the next bar. Two bars separate the last fit outcome from the first later decision. Causal feature history is reused across the boundary; that is not label leakage.
validation.finalHoldout: The confirmation window, evaluated once for the frozen candidate package and comparators, only if the development gates select a candidate; otherwise it stays sealed.

iql.betaRationale: Rewards are scaled by 100, so one-step advantages are of order 0.05. beta was set on a synthetic constant-drift toy with a known optimum (beta 3 left the policy at the behaviour mean), never on market outcomes.

ppo_risk.description: PPO with a registered variance penalty: learner reward r - 0.5*r^2 on the scaled reward. Compared against unshaped PPO; the economic ledger is unchanged.

policies.network: Two tanh hidden layers of 64 units; NumPy with hand-written gradients; CPU only.
policies.actionHandling: Learners see the clipped raw proposal. The shield is part of the transition. PPO log-probabilities, TD3 critic inputs and IQL regression targets all refer to that proposal. Known consequence: the TD3 actor gradient is zero wherever the shield projects.

champion.name: champion_method
champion.definition: Per-bar positions exported by the repository's trader-hs CLI running --method ta_regime_switch --positioning long-short --interval 6h --open-threshold 0.001 --close-threshold 0.001 --fee 0.0005 --slippage 0.00015 --spread 0.0003 --funding-rate 0 --max-position-size 0.1666 --stop-loss 0.0753 --take-profit 0.0353, replayed as target exposures on the common ledger.
champion.fidelity: Code-faithful, parameter-approximate. Stop and take-profit are medians of four combos recorded in untracked 2026-10-27 operations evidence; the six combos pinned on 2026-11-11 are not available locally. Intrabar stop exits appear one bar late on the common ledger. The production parameters were optimised on data through 2026, so any production-champion comparison on these windows would favour the champion.
champion.unavailableBaselineGate: No superiority claim over the pinned production combos, and no promotion, without matched exports of those combos.

offlineDataset.behavior: Per-episode mixture: 35% regime rule + N(0, 0.3), 35% ridge forecast + N(0, 0.3), 15% mean-reverting random walk, 15% uniform

ablations.ppo_no_context: PPO with funding and BTC-context features zeroed (alternative-data ablation).
ablations.ppo_unshielded_diagnostic: The trained PPO evaluated with the shield disabled, in simulation only; diagnostic, never a candidate.

seedRule: Every seed is reported. The seed aggregate is the mean of the seeds' per-bar returns (equal capital per seed). No seed is selected.
checkpointRule: For each fit, the checkpoint with the highest inner-validation fleet Sharpe at base cost; ties go to the earliest. Test data is never used.

budget.hyperparameterSearch: none; one fixed configuration per learner

metrics.aggregate: Fleet series: per-bar sum of the six fleet symbols' account returns, pooled over the four test folds. BTC is reported separately.
metrics.primary: Annualised mean per-bar net fleet return of the seed aggregate minus that of each comparator, with a 95% stationary-bootstrap interval (mean block 28 bars, 2000 draws).
secondary: per fold, per symbol, per seed

statistics.dsr: scripts/research/diagnostics.py deflated_sharpe_ratio over every evaluated variant's pooled fleet series; gate >= 0.95.
statistics.sampleNote: Seeds and symbols are not independent market histories and do not multiply the sample size. An undefined statistic is reported as insufficient evidence.

ope.realLogs: None are available to this task. No estimate is produced for real logged behaviour.
ope.simulated: FQE of the IQL and behaviour-cloning policies on the simulated dataset, compared with simulator ground truth from the same start states. Importance sampling is defined in proposal space for a stochastic form of the target (Gaussian, std 0.3); effective sample size is reported by horizon. Deterministic targets have zero support and are not evaluated by importance sampling.

disabledChallengerEligible: Primary difference lower bound > 0 against cash, buy_and_hold, regime_rule, ridge_forecast and champion_method
Point estimate of the primary difference >= materiality against each of those comparators
Still positive against each comparator at cost2x and delay1bar (point estimate)
Max drawdown within the non-inferiority margin
At least 4 of 5 seeds individually positive against the best comparator
No executable intent outside the shield's admitted set
Critical formal obligations for the path discharged
Confirmation window evaluated once with a positive primary point estimate

trialAccounting: Every policy variant in this file is a trial: 3 RL learners, 1 extension, 1 ablation, 1 diagnostic, 7 non-RL comparators. Any successor configuration is a new registered trial.
artifacts: .tmp/research/exposure-rl-v1 (ignored by git): data snapshots, run registry, policies, per-bar evaluation series.
